column1: # CC-BY-4.0. Own substantive judgments after full text/context reads; one-based ordinals.

2|PASS|Personal relevance and future possibilities support an orientation-intent classification. Explaining curricular gains must not become a graded Physics recall task; actual non-graded orientation wording and closure are still pending.

3,134|PASS|Density measurement and predicting behavior in a medium contain different physical demonstrations. Broad assessable-content triage is supported; a density quotient alone does not prove buoyancy reasoning.
4,135|PASS|Guided experiment planning, execution and mean-speed determination form one coherent physical measurement product candidate.

5,136|needs_revision|The source explicitly makes documentation serve comparison of movement. A suitable representation and its interpretation can form one coherent physical analysis; independent verbs do not prove compulsory splitting. Momentary speed must remain within its eventual evidence.

6,137|PASS|Qualitative force-effect prediction is one physical reasoning candidate; identifying forces and choosing inertia/superposition are part of its explanation. Broad vector arithmetic is not universally required merely by this text.
7,138|PASS|Static/sliding friction coefficients plus technical braking applications require distinguishable physical evidence; the full broad target is not mastered by one sliding-friction number.
8,139|PASS|Using incline force effects to justify safe traffic behavior is assessable physical transfer. A relevance discussion with correctness requirements is content, not orientation.
10,141|PASS|Lever, fixed/moving pulley and tackle systems have different physical arrangements; the full experimental bundle is wider than one machine principle.
11,142|PASS|Identifying a lever's forces/pivot and explaining its device function form one coherent physical device-analysis candidate.
12,143|PASS|Describing a mechanical process as idealized energy conversion is one conceptual physical model candidate; everyday wording must not replace the actual conversion account.

13,144|needs_revision|The local promise of location and instantaneous speed at arbitrary times is underdetermined by energy conservation alone. A time law or dynamical route must be supplied or taught within a bounded physical model. Ideal versus dissipative versions need evidence, but their difference alone is not proof of a mandatory split.
14,145|PASS|The full force/energy/work/power concept map and unit conversion cover several physical quantities and a distinct numerical routine. Source-bound operational boundaries remain needed.

16,81|needs_revision|A mechanical analogy can be a representation method for explaining the same circuit functions. The text does not establish that explaining by analogy must be a separate competence; a broad circuit content boundary is still needed.
17,82|PASS|Circuit representation, resistance measurement and electrical danger appraisal have independent success conditions, so broad practical content triage is justified.
18,83|PASS|Building a network, calculating several electrical quantities and evaluating safe household loading demand substantive practical and physical checks beyond a single resistance result.
19,84|PASS|Device energy conversions, current effects and efficiency can be a coherent physical device-energy explanation candidate.

20,85|needs_revision|The text requires well-founded sustainable supply argumentation but does not require an independent political/economic judgment skill. A physics-based criteria argument with supplied context is constructive. Keep interdisciplinary ownership and compulsory splitting unresolved instead of promoting them from the word sustainability.
22,147|PASS|Contrasting three material states within the same particle model is an assessable physical conceptual candidate, without an implied chemical-reaction target.
23,148|PASS|Length and volume changes across solids/liquids require distinct measured quantities and models. Broad thermal-expansion triage is supported, without approving exact splits.
24,149|PASS|Explaining an expansion thermometer and selecting it for a measurement is one coherent physical device-selection candidate.
25,150|PASS|The particle-model absolute-zero argument and Kelvin scale follow one physical explanation chain; abstract number-scale mastery is not inferred.
26,151|PASS|Inferring a material's specific heat from heat/temperature data is a bounded physical parameter measurement candidate.
27,152|PASS|An observed mixture temperature and model check under equal specific heats form one bounded physical verification candidate. Unequal heat capacities and phase changes are absent here.

28,153|PASS|Microscopic phase-transition explanation and quantitative latent-heat applications are distinct physical evidence aspects. The broad triage is supported; source formulas and a future exact division still need review.
29,154|PASS|Conduction, radiation and convection use genuinely different mechanisms; explaining lake stratification through convection does not evidence the other mechanisms.
31,87|PASS|Shadow/eclipses and lunar phases have different geometrical causes. The full content bundle needs explicit checks preventing the false shadow explanation of ordinary phases.
32,88|PASS|Reflection, refraction and total reflection are different physical laws/conditions; index/critical-angle measurement and light-guide explanation form only part of the full bundle.
33,89|PASS|A lens-image construction/measurement and eye-defect explanations require different physical model applications, supporting broader optical-content triage.

34,90|PASS|The explicitly historical and present-use optical-device research has nonexclusive interdisciplinary content intent. It is assessable source-based communication, not motivation; a fixed owner or mandatory prerequisite in History is not established.
35,91|PASS|Primary/secondary source distinction serves a single physical explanation of receiving direct/scattered light while seeing.
38|PASS|Reference-frame positions, finite sampling and mean/approximate instantaneous velocity form a bounded stroboscopic motion-analysis candidate.
39|PASS|Uniform and uniformly accelerated linear movement have distinct laws and experimental interpretations, supporting a two-model broad outcome.
40|PASS|Diagram interpretation and quantitative coordinate modeling with traffic evaluation form broader applied kinematics content; exact model and evidence boundary remain necessary.
41|PASS|Velocity-to-distance and acceleration-to-velocity areas carry different physical quantities and units; full coverage of both relations is broader than a single area reading.
43|PASS|Using Newton laws and a force diagram for a qualitative everyday motion forecast is one physical modeling candidate, including the correct system choice.
44|PASS|Computing force/mass/acceleration to explain a cushioning device is a coherent physical transfer candidate. Injury claims would need supplied context, not inferred medical mastery.
45|PASS|Incline motion with or without friction can be variants of one one-body force-model candidate; both model assumptions must remain explicit.
47,106|PASS|Circular kinematic quantities and the force causing centripetal acceleration are distinct physical content aspects; broad triage is supported across both actual scopes.
48,107|PASS|A radial acceleration/force relation inferred from data with Newton reasoning is one physical law-identification candidate.
49|PASS|Using a circular force model to judge a traffic speed limit is one coherent physical decision candidate; examples do not require political traffic-law knowledge.
50|PASS|Explaining guards and maximum rotation rate from physical hazards is assessable safety transfer, not an orientation completion.
52|PASS|Mechanically interpreting everyday energy transformations and separating everyday from physical terminology is one conceptual energy candidate.

53,69|PASS|Estimating work from a supplied force-versus-path graph is a bounded physical accumulation method. Full analytical integration is not automatically necessary when elementarily geometric data are supplied.
54|PASS|An open combination of force, energy, work, power and efficiency needs several physical relations and judgments; broad applied-content triage is supported.

55|needs_revision|The source explicitly makes efficiency calculations serve the judgment of efficient use. A coherent physical energy-account task with supplied environmental facts is possible. A separate societal competence/owner and a compulsory split are not universally proved by Mensch und Umwelt.
57|PASS|Magnitude and direction are components of the same velocity vector in stroboscopic curved motion; their determination is a coherent physical measurement candidate.
58|PASS|The accelerated-motion wording is not confined to uniform acceleration, and the target includes distinct experimental models/data transformations. Do not quietly restrict it from year labels.
59|PASS|Three kinematic diagrams, slopes and accumulated changes across variable acceleration form a genuine broad relation bundle.
60|PASS|Selecting/interpreting a linear or quadratic movement model, with parameters and validity domain, is one assessable physical modeling process candidate.
61|PASS|A chosen projectile model, vector forecast and video check can form one coherent physical prediction/verification candidate; native tasks must still cover the specified sports transfer.
63|PASS|Forecasting a force-induced velocity change and checking it empirically are one physical law-testing process candidate.
64|PASS|Numerical and graphical force diagrams are methods for one Newtonian motion forecast. They do not force the union of all available mathematical methods into requires.
65|PASS|A driven/frictional incline and an Atwood coupled system require different system choices and constraints; the target is a broad mechanics bundle.
66|PASS|One- and two-dimensional collisions need different component/system conditions and outputs. The full target is wider than one scalar collision calculation.
68|PASS|Qualitative transformations and quantitative work-energy balance can form one coherent physical energy-account candidate; they do not certify independent abstract arithmetic mastery.
70|PASS|A looping motion and a central collision require different force/energy/momentum model choices, supporting broad integrative mechanics content.
72|PASS|A data transformation and physically interpreting a fitted proportionality constant can be one empirical-law inference process candidate. Exact universal Math methods remain undecided.

73|PASS|Text-based theory acquisition and an open range of independent practical experiments have substantial broader process coverage; concrete native evidence is required rather than a research-label mastery marker.

74|needs_revision|Designing and evaluating the same experiment can be one coherent design-quality competence. Error appraisal is a validity condition of that product, not a proven separate atom; the source expressly limits error calculation and must not be expanded to full statistics.
75|PASS|Digital measurement, graphing and theory-based regression can be one coherent physical data-analysis process candidate. Regression is not necessarily a free-standing Math outcome.
76|PASS|A formal physically correct protocol is one assessable communication product with several necessary sections; section count alone does not justify splitting.
77|PASS|An open research cycle of hypothesis, experiment design, execution, reflection and presentation covers broad empirical capabilities; a curriculum axis alone is insufficient for mastery.
78|PASS|Video-derived kinematics and inferring acting forces add distinguishable dynamical reasoning, supporting a broad physical analysis target.
93|PASS|Pressure/volume/temperature/heat distinctions and numerical unit conversions cover a family of physical quantities rather than one small measurement.

94|needs_revision|Phase changes and unequal specific heats are cases of the same energy-based mixture problem. The extra balance terms need real evidence; their presence does not by itself prove a mandatory separate goal.

95|needs_revision|The explicit process develops one gas equation from measurements and interprets it in the ideal-gas model. Data display, synthesis and interpretation can be one coherent empirical-model construction; compulsory splitting is not established by the steps.
96|PASS|Computing a changed ideal-gas state under the same law is one physical model application; alternative unknowns/context examples do not create new owners.
97|PASS|A closed p-V area and its work meaning constitute one physical process-account candidate.
98|PASS|Assessing a real process by the same efficiency criterion is a physical judgment candidate; no independent economic/political value criterion is stated.
99|PASS|Interpreting prepared conduction sources to present heat-transport control is an assessable physical communication candidate, with the source preparation scope preserved.
101|PASS|Continuity quantification and laminar/turbulent mechanism identification are different physical content areas, supporting broad fluid-dynamics triage.
102|PASS|Bernoulli derivation and stagnation pressure as its consequence can form one physical energy-law reasoning candidate.
103|PASS|Applying continuity/Bernoulli to flow phenomena is a coherent physical explanatory method candidate; the examples are alternative applications.

104|PASS|Explaining viscous profiles and matching pipe cross-section with flow rate add a substantive design requirement. The quantitative constitutive/boundary model must be source-bounded before tasks are written.
108|PASS|Banked-curve force components add a distinct geometric/dynamical case beyond a flat-curve speed limit. Broad traffic-dynamics triage is supported.
109|PASS|Satellite orbit modeling and choosing suitable communications/navigation/observation uses require several physical/model-application criteria; eventual task-supplied facts remain allowed.
111|PASS|Amplitude, period and frequency characterize one measured oscillation; planning that measurement is part of the same physical product candidate.

112,190|needs_revision|The displacement, velocity and acceleration phase relations plus phasors can be one harmonic-motion representation competence. Alternative displays and several dependent coordinates do not prove compulsory splitting; native coverage of all named quantities remains mandatory.

113|PASS|Inferring which system parameters govern oscillation period is one physical empirical-model process candidate. No specific function family or universal Math set is supplied by the year heading.
114,192|PASS|Establishing a restoring-force model and linking a larger energy/frequency/parameter network over several pendula gives broader physical content than one period evaluation.
115,193|PASS|An ideal oscillation energy account and qualitative dissipative damping explanation have different physical assumptions and mechanisms; broad triage is supported.
116|PASS|Longitudinal/transverse propagation and a quantitative space-time phase model constitute broad wave content.
117|PASS|Predicting qualitative single-aperture diffraction with Huygens/superposition is one physical model candidate; quantitative trig/integral mastery is not inferred.
118|PASS|Two-source interference and counterpropagating standing waves require different geometric and boundary conditions; one maximum calculation does not evidence both.
119|PASS|Qualitative resonance and a measure affecting that same system can be one physical cause-and-action judgment candidate, with alternative everyday contexts.

120|needs_revision|Fixed/free-end phases and the eigenfrequency sequence may form one boundary-condition resonance argument. Multiple parts of that explanation do not alone establish an obligatory split; all phase/boundary and numerical aspects still need evidence.

122|PASS|Constructing a field-line representation and interpreting homogeneity/symmetry is a coherent physical representation candidate; general abstract graph skills are not automatically independent Math requirements.
123|PASS|Electric probe-charge force and magnetic current-carrying-probe force use different laws and measurements. Broad field-strength triage is supported.

124|PASS|Potential and field-strength functions from energy and force have different definitions and link conditions, supporting a broad field-description candidate. No generally multivariable method is imposed by this wording.
125|PASS|A charged body's motion in a homogeneous electric field is one physical model candidate using suitable force/energy methods; alternative routes must not become a universal Math AND set.
126|PASS|Dielectric effects, capacitor parameters and selecting/dimensioning different capacitor constructions give substantial broader component-physics content.

127|needs_revision|Planning a capacitor experiment to obtain its parameters can be one coherent measurement competence. Planning is not a separate atom merely because the apparatus/parameters must be chosen; coverage and indirect-measurement assumptions need native review.
129|PASS|Obtaining induction voltage from a flux-time diagram by the induction law is a specific physical forecast candidate. Mathematical necessity depends on the actual diagram/task route.
130|PASS|The constant-field and constant-area cases are variants of the same induction-law calculation candidate; the technical voltage scale remains its physical plausibility check.
131|PASS|Switching transients, risk/use appraisal and quantitative real-coil parameter determination add genuinely distinct physical evidence aspects.
156|PASS|Electric, magnetic, combined-field and relativistic device models require substantially different physical laws/conditions; the full target is broad.
157|PASS|Charge, specific charge, quantization and relativistic interpretation need different experiments/inferences, supporting broad particle measurement content.

158|PASS|Source-based high-energy research history and an explicit societal criticism judgment support nonexclusive interdisciplinary assessable content. It is not a motivational orientation or a proof of a new political prerequisite.
160|PASS|Ideal LC energy exchange and real damping have distinct physical assumptions/mechanisms, supporting broad oscillation-content triage.
161|PASS|Phase-shifted electrical quantities, energy conservation and component-to-frequency relations extend beyond one LC parameter calculation.
162|PASS|Passive LC frequency dimensioning and active feedback are different physical/technical mechanisms; broad classification is justified.

163|needs_revision|Amplitude response and phase response are coupled evidence for the same resonance/energy-transfer judgment. An integrated measured response analysis is constructive; compulsory splitting cannot follow from graph count alone.
164|PASS|Transfer from a closed circuit to an open dipole and simultaneous time/space near-field modeling constitute substantial broader electromagnetic representation content.
165|PASS|Antenna orientation/field coupling and frequency-dependent optimum length require different physical checks, including ring versus rod antennas.
166|PASS|Interference, standing-wave formation and medium-dependent propagation join distinct electromagnetic wave conditions/measurements.
167|PASS|Identifying light by wave experiments and evaluating radiation-use risk/protection are different physical evidence tasks; no biological mastery is inferred where supplied effects suffice.
168|PASS|Wavelength inversion, slit-count intensity behavior and order-dependent maximum/minimum angles constitute broad diffraction content.

169|PASS|Emission-source spectrum comparison and quantitative line/band measurement constitute broader spectroscopy content. The literal coherence condition for glowing/gas sources needs source-level precision; no false claim of wholly coherent broadband emission may be introduced.

170|needs_revision|A measured lattice constant can serve the technical suitability judgment in one investigation. Measurement and evaluating its use do not alone prove a compulsory split; actual suitability criteria must be preserved in the rubric.
172|PASS|Classical/quantum model comparison, single-event probabilities and wavelength determination join distinct quantum content/inference demands.
173|PASS|Which-path complementarity and position-momentum uncertainty are distinct principles; a world-view summary is not evidence that each is mastered.
174|PASS|Bragg-based electron analysis and feasibility for different quantum objects require substantive different evidence; the de Broglie relation's data-based derivation must be retained.
175|PASS|Photoelectric line parameters and a general quantized energy/momentum interaction explanation are broader content than slope extraction alone.
176|PASS|Electron/photon excitation, transition frequency calculation and hydrogen-series interpretation give a genuine multi-model atom-physics bundle.

177|PASS|Choosing a quantum potential model, obtaining boundary-conditioned eigenstates and interpreting state probabilities require distinguishable physical evidence. Abstract differential/integral prerequisites are not approved by this classification.
178|PASS|Testing a potential-well spectral model and assigning many-electron states using Pauli are different physical model problems.

179|PASS|X-ray production, spectral/Bragg analysis and explicitly health-based medical use yield nonexclusive interdisciplinary broad content. No medical owner transfer or biology prerequisite follows automatically.

181|PASS|Relating accelerator energy to scattering resolution is a coherent physical quantitative candidate including the explicitly relativistic part; a simple classical calculation does not establish complete mastery.
182|PASS|Nuclear stability and binding-energy reaction yield require different physical explanations and balances, supporting broad nuclear content.
183|PASS|Alpha tunneling, beta quark transformations, gamma transitions and detection/energy measurements are different physical mechanisms and outcomes.
184|PASS|Reaction equation, mass balance and energy sign form one physical reaction-classification candidate.
185|PASS|Alpha/beta spectra, daughter excitation and gamma level energies use distinct physical interpretation conditions; broad spectral-balance triage is supported.

186|needs_revision|The fitted decay parameters explicitly support the technical application judgment in the same source clause. That may be one coherent data-to-use investigation; compulsory splitting from two verbs is unproved. An exact decay model and suitability criterion are still needed.

187|PASS|Explicit tissue effects, dosimetry, detector principles and medical benefit/risk give nonexclusive interdisciplinary broad content. They are assessed reasoning, not orientation; supplied biological facts may be used without inventing Biology mastery.
189|PASS|Inferring amplitude, period and frequency from experiment data is one physical oscillation-characterization candidate; no full independent planning requirement is added here.

191|PASS|Forward harmonic values and inverse periodic time conditions require different computational reasoning, particularly completeness of repeated times. Broader triage is supported without turning all trig methods into prerequisites.

195|PASS|Wave generation/propagation and measured wavelength/frequency/speed can be one coherent experimental characterization candidate. Wanne/Maschine are source methods whose full coverage still needs review.
196|PASS|Huygens/superposition explain one diffraction phenomenon qualitatively; the absence of quantitative demand must be respected.
197|PASS|Constructing the resultant amplitude to locate two-circle-wave maxima/minima is one physical interference decision candidate, not an independent abstract geometry goal.
198|PASS|A grating wavelength measurement establishes wave behavior but does not alone establish electromagnetic identity. Both physically different evidence requirements need coverage.

200|PASS|Nuclear energy calculation plus explicitly economic/ecological/waste criteria supports nonexclusive interdisciplinary broad content. No automatic new owner or universal economics mastery is approved.
201|PASS|A natural decay explained and represented by a nuclear reaction equation is one physical transformation candidate, without implied chemical-reaction mastery.
202|PASS|Radiation-type distinctions and relating them to different detector principles have broader physical coverage; exact chosen detector mechanisms need native bounds.

203|PASS|Decay-time exposure, biological/environmental effects, attenuation and distance-based protection are distinct physical/application aspects. Interdisciplinary interpretation is nonexclusive; effects may be supplied, and no new Biology requires edge is approved.
204|PASS|Activity/half-life and absorbed/equivalent dose have different quantities and physical meanings; a broad dosimetry/risk bundle is supported.
